title: Upgrading the Moderation API with our new multimodal moderation model
summary: We’re introducing a new model built on GPT-4o that is more accurate at detecting harmful text and images, enabling developers to build more robust moderation systems.
body: We’re introducing a new model built on GPT-4o that is more accurate at detecting harmful text and images, enabling developers to build more robust moderation systems.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推出基于GPT-4o构建的全新多模态内容审核模型。该模型能够同时处理文本与图像数据，相比以往版本在检测有害内容方面具备更高的准确性，助力开发者构建更健壮的安全审核系统。原始信息显示：We’re introducing a new model built on GPT-4o that is more accurate at detecting harmful text and images, enabling developers to build more robust moderation systems.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Upgrading the Moderation API with our new multimodal moderation model”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了基于GPT-4o构建的新型多模态内容审核模型，显著提升了有害文本和图像的检测能力。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
